授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 現代日本社会における、文化的、民族的な多様性および人口統計的な特性や変化に焦点をあて、その歴史的背景と、現代社会での状況、およびこれからの展望などについてディスカッションを行います。また、社会学的観点に基づいた基礎知識と考察力を培うことで、現代日本社会全体の理解を深めます。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Japan has long been recognized—both by its own citizens and those from abroad—as a fundamentally “homogeneous society.” This perception largely stems from the limited visibility of cultural and demographic diversity within its population. However, Japan has a history of hosting and socially constructing diverse groups defined by various racial, ethnic, national, and cultural backgrounds, which are often regarded as distinct by the majority of society.
This course aims to introduce students to the cultural and demographic diversity in contemporary Japanese society, as well as the inequalities that exist among selected groups. It will explore, from an international perspective, how specific ethnic groups and minority populations in Japan experience different forms of assimilation, exclusion, and inequality, along with any privileges they may possess in relation to the majority population.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Diversity; Demography; Minorities; Population; Japan; Society; Culture; Social Relations
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: This is an all-English course designed originally for international/exchange students. Nonetheless, domestic students, including Japanese students, are strongly encouraged to join, and it’s not required to possess a certain level of proficiency in English to formally enroll in this course. However, if you are not a native English speaker, it’s important to possess a minimum level of English skills necessary to meaningfully participate in and successfully complete this course. This course advises that you possess a minimum TOEFL score of 79 (IBT) or IELTS 6.0.
